clips.send: When the piece is bigger than what you have, not even one piece fits. 1 over 2 divided by 3 over 4 : the half fills only 2 of the 3 quarters in a piece, so the answer is 1 over 2 times 4 over 3 equals 2 over 3 of a piece.
clips.text: When the piece is bigger than what you have, not even one piece fits. over 12 div over 34: the half fills only 2 of the 3 quarters in a piece, so the answer is over 12 times over 43 = over 23 of a piece.

clips.send: Same question with a fraction: 4 divided by 1 over 2 , how many halves fit in 4? Every whole holds 2 halves, so 4 wholes hold 8. Dividing by 1 over 2 gives more, not less!
clips.text: Same question with a fraction: 4 div over 1 2 , how many halves fit in 4? Every whole holds 2 halves, so 4 wholes hold 8. Dividing by over 12 gives more, not less!

clips.send: Another way to see it: dividing by 2 over 3 is two moves. How many thirds? Multiply by 3, so 3 becomes 9 thirds. How many groups of 2 thirds? Divide by 2. Together: times 3 over 2 , the reciprocal of 2 over 3 .
clips.text: Another way to see it: dividing by over 23 is two moves. How many thirds? Multiply by 3, so 3 becomes 9 thirds. How many groups of 2 thirds? Divide by 2. Together: times over 3 2 , the reciprocal of over 23.

clips.send: Now 4 divided by 2 over 3 . First cut every whole into thirds: 12 thirds in all. Each yellow piece is 2 thirds long, so 12 divided by 2 equals 6 pieces fit.
clips.text: Now 4 div over 2 3 . First cut every whole into thirds: 12 thirds in all. Each yellow piece is 2 thirds long, so 12 div 2 = 6 pieces fit.

clips.send: Why does this work? Measure everything in the same unit, thirds. 3 is 9 over 3 and a piece is 2 over 3 . How many 2s fit in 9? 9 over 3 divided by 2 over 3 equals 9 divided by 2 equals 4 and 1 over 2 . Same denominator, so just divide the numerators.
clips.text: Why does this work? Measure everything in the same unit, thirds. 3 is over 93 and a piece is over 23. How many 2s fit in 9? over 93 div over 23 = 9 div 2 = 4 over 12. Same denominator, so just divide the numerators.

clips.send: In general, give both fractions the same denominator bd , then divide the numerators: ad over bd divided by bc over bd equals ad over bc . That is exactly a over b times d over c : multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor.
clips.text: In general, give both fractions the same denominator bd, then divide the numerators: over ad bd div over bc bd = over ad bc . That is exactly over a b times over d c : multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor.

clips.send: Start with whole numbers. 6 divided by 2 asks: how many 2s fit in 6? Lay pieces of length 2 under a bar of length 6. Three fit, so 6 divided by 2 equals 3 .
clips.text: Start with whole numbers. 6 div 2 asks: how many 2s fit in 6? Lay pieces of length 2 under a bar of length 6. Three fit, so 6 div 2 = 3.

clips.send: What if it does not fit evenly? In 3 divided by 2 over 3 , four pieces fit and 1 over 3 is left over. That leftover is half a piece, so the answer is 4 and 1 over 2 , not 4 and 1 over 3 .
clips.text: What if it does not fit evenly? In 3 div over 2 3 , four pieces fit and over 13 is left over. That leftover is half a piece, so the answer is 4 over 12, not 4 over 13.

clips.send: Worked example: you have 2 and 1 over 2 cups of rice and one serving is 3 over 4 cup. 5 over 2 divided by 3 over 4 equals 5 over 2 times 4 over 3 equals 20 over 6 equals 3 and 1 over 3 : three full servings and a third of another.
clips.text: Worked example: you have 2 over 12 cups of rice and one serving is over 34 cup. over 52 div over 34 = over 52 times over 43 = over 20 6 = 3 over 13: three full servings and a third of another.

clips.send: 为什么这样算？把所有东西都用同一个单位—— 3分之1 ——来量。3 是 3分之9 ，一份是 3分之2 。9 里面有几个 2? 3分之9 除以 3分之2 等于 9 除以 2 等于 4又 2分之1 。分母相同，只要把分子相除。
clips.text: 为什么这样算？把所有东西都用同一个单位—— over 13——来量。3 是 over 93，一份是 over 23。9 里面有几个 2? over 93 div over 23 = 9 div 2 = 4 over 12。分母相同，只要把分子相除。

clips.send: 先从整数开始。 6 除以 2 问的是：6 里面有几个 2？在长度为 6 的蓝条下面摆长度为 2 的黄条。正好摆下 3 个，所以 6 除以 2 等于 3 。
clips.text: 先从整数开始。6 div 2 问的是：6 里面有几个 2？在长度为 6 的蓝条下面摆长度为 2 的黄条。正好摆下 3 个，所以 6 div 2 = 3。

clips.send: 如果一份比你拥有的还大，就连一份都放不满。 2分之1 除以 4分之3 ： 2分之1 只能填满一份里 3 个 4分之1 中的 2 个，所以答案是 2分之1 乘 3分之4 等于 3分之2 份。
clips.text: 如果一份比你拥有的还大，就连一份都放不满。 over 12 div over 34： over 12 只能填满一份里 3 个 over 14 中的 2 个，所以答案是 over 12 times over 43 = over 23 份。

clips.send: 容易混淆：余下的部分要用“份”来计量，而不是用“整体 1”。3 除以 3分之2 能放下 4 份，还剩 3分之1；这 3分之1 是半份，所以答案是 4½，不是 4⅓。另外，只把除数颠倒，被除数不要动！
clips.text: 容易混淆：余下的部分要用“份”来计量，而不是用“整体 1”。3 ÷ 2/3 能放下 4 份，还剩 1/3；这 1/3 是半份，所以答案是 4½，不是 4⅓。另外，只把除数颠倒，被除数不要动！

clips.send: 如果放不整呢？ 3 除以 3分之2 能放下 4 份，还剩 3分之1 。剩下的这部分只是半份，所以答案是 4又 2分之1 ，不是 4又 3分之1 。
clips.text: 如果放不整呢？3 div over 2 3 能放下 4 份，还剩 over 13。剩下的这部分只是半份，所以答案是 4 over 12，不是 4 over 13。

clips.send: 再看 4 除以 3分之2 。先把每个 1 都切成三等份：一共 12 个 3分之1 。每个黄条长 2 个 3分之1 ，所以能放下 12 除以 2 等于 6 个。
clips.text: 再看 4 div over 2 3 。先把每个 1 都切成三等份：一共 12 个 over 13。每个黄条长 2 个 over 13，所以能放下 12 div 2 = 6 个。

clips.send: 一般地，先把两个分数通分成相同的分母 bd ，再把分子相除： bd分之ad 除以 bd分之bc 等于 bc分之ad 。这正好等于 b分之a 乘 c分之d ：除以一个分数，等于乘它的倒数。
clips.text: 一般地，先把两个分数通分成相同的分母 bd，再把分子相除： over ad bd div over bc bd = over ad bc 。这正好等于 over a b times over d c ：除以一个分数，等于乘它的倒数。

clips.send: 还可以这样看：除以 3分之2 分两步。先问“有几个 3分之1 ”：乘 3，得到 9 个 3分之1 。再问“每 2 个一组能分几组”：除以 2。两步合起来就是 乘 2分之3 ，正好是 3分之2 的倒数。
clips.text: 还可以这样看：除以 over 23 分两步。先问“有几个 over 13”：乘 3，得到 9 个 over 13。再问“每 2 个一组能分几组”：除以 2。两步合起来就是 times over 3 2 ，正好是 over 23 的倒数。

clips.send: 换成分数，问题不变： 4 除以 2分之1 ,4 里面有几个 2分之1 ？每个 1 里有 2 个 2分之1 ,4 里就有 8 个。除以 2分之1 ，结果反而变大了！
clips.text: 换成分数，问题不变：4 div over 1 2 ,4 里面有几个 over 12？每个 1 里有 2 个 over 12,4 里就有 8 个。除以 over 12，结果反而变大了！

clips.send: 例题：你有 2又 2分之1 杯米，每份 4分之3 杯。 2分之5 除以 4分之3 等于 2分之5 乘 3分之4 等于 6分之20 等于 3又 3分之1 ：可以盛满 3 份，还能再盛 3分之1 份。
clips.text: 例题：你有 2 over 12 杯米，每份 over 34 杯。 over 52 div over 34 = over 52 times over 43 = over 20 6 = 3 over 13：可以盛满 3 份，还能再盛 over 13 份。
